title: Midas's Decor
body:
# Midas Decor
This is a Gold Based decoration and weapons 

The main weapons are
- _**The Spade**_: A simple cross between a sword and a shovel
- _**Midas Slice**_: An easy cleaver that kills people in vain
- **_The Golden Katana_**: An ancient relic that allows you to wave dash towards your enemies


## Decorative Blocks
All decorative blocks can be made in the stonecutter by inserting a gold block
- Polished Gold Block
- Smooth Gold Block
- Chiseled Gold Block
- Golden Bricks
- Cracked Golden Bricks
- Golden Pillar
- Golden Tiles
- Cut Gold Block
- Karated Gold Block


###  Miscelanious items
- Rift Cracker
- Syringes
- Gold Deconstructor
